articles.title: School Food
articles.author: Charlotte Jones
articles.excerpt: School food it's not always the topic of discussion, but it's very important to learn about what schools are feeding our students. In this article it will discuss how school food is now. How it is outside and inside TLC, how nutritious it is, and how the students of TLC can benefit from it.
articles.body:
What is wrong with American school food nowadays? It seems as though every video you scroll through about school food is another bad apple being served to students. But is our school food healthy? In this article we will talk about American school food and how our school food compares.

    How is American school food now?

    Public schools are probably the most affected by the non-nutritious foods. Sadly most schools aren’t paid enough from the government, so the food nutrition decreases. Their food is described as being unhealthy, and students would rather skip lunch than eat their school lunch. School lunch should be reliable and consumable, and from videos people show their school food is far from it, sadly mainly due to the schools budget. The good side of school food is, it’s a sustenance kids can eat when they're hungry. It's good to have something in your stomach for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.  

    Is TLC’s food any better?

    TLC food is a nutritious lunch for kids to eat. It not only has Lunch provided, but students can also get breakfast from 8:05 to 9:45. Our school shows what school lunch will be.

    When you're outside you’ll see what’s on the menu. A huge whiteboard shows what type of food we can receive, before having to wait in a long line. Not only that but TLC offers a “Share Table” where if there's food on your tray you may not want, that's unopened and untouched. You can put it in a box, so students don't waste it, and others have a little extra snack. Something that stands out is that TLC has different options, multiple choices. Like non-meat options for vegetarians and soy milk for the lactose intolerant. Our school is inclusive and shows it values their students' overall health. 

    When going inside the lunch room, just walking in students see nutrition posters. It also describes the food they’re serving. The food is separated, and students are required to at least grab one fruit or vegetable. And are welcome to put it in the share box if the students don’t feel like eating an item. After you pick your lunch, there's also a fridge that also stores food. It makes sure food  stays cold during the California heat.

    So students of TLC should be glad to have this wide variety of food options, flexible times to get food, and nutritious meals that are FREE. So next time you get yourself a tray of breakfast or lunch, make sure to thank them for that beneficial meal.
